scenario: Cancelled late, outside the 72-hour window; only the earlier charge is paid.

coverage.reasoning: A parent's stroke is a covered reason (2.1(a)). He learned of it on 2026-09-02 but cancelled on 2026-09-10, after the 72 hours in 2.3. 72 hours on (2026-09-05) the trip was 10 days away, so the riad would have charged 450, not 900. Payable: flight 620 + 450 = 1,070.
